title: Q-VALUE-GEOMETRY-v001 full pipeline versus frozen native DPR, exposed B1 multi-seed screen
claim_scope: Ordinary method-level useful retrieval benefit over frozen DPR multiset on the same exposed128-question B1 development screen. No advantage over adapted HEAD or matched classical replacements is claimed. This grade is not portable-package readiness.
hypothesis: The trained full pipeline can improve useful Top5 selection over the unadapted frozen native scoring model.

assumptions: Same frozen source/input/role/train labels and native DPR weights.
Held out from adapter optimization only; exposed-development limitations retained.
theory.implementation_plan: Exact archived method; original full planned training and all final predictions completed. Close numerical/portability debt without changing method or selecting new settings.

comparison.metric: operational useful selected count out of640
comparison.method_identity: Q-VALUE-GEOMETRY-v001 archived final256-step full pipeline, source 1e9d1b12e66695a1d4b70471fbf5a809e7cc7bf4

attribution.mechanism: The quantum-containing full pipeline is not shown superior to adapted HEAD and matched classical replacements. This does not erase its named ordinary-method benefit over frozen native DPR.

limitations: Scope is the complete adapted pipeline versus frozen native DPR; it does not establish quantum-module contribution.
